notes.title: Price Drop - $6.99 to $3.99

notes.title: Announcing Achromatic!
notes.content:
Our new game is coming out in three weeks. We listened to your feedback from Hex and Hex Two to make Achromatic the best it can be. Please add it to your wishlist and thank you for your support!
